achievements.name: Keep Clash
achievements.detail: Win the opening battle against Bowser in his castle.

achievements.name: Mallow Joins
achievements.detail: Have Mallow join the party after helping him on Mushroom Way.

achievements.name: Geno Joins
achievements.detail: Have Geno join the party in the forest beyond Rose Town.

achievements.name: Bowser Joins
achievements.detail: Have Bowser join the party during the events at Booster Tower.

achievements.name: Peach Joins
achievements.detail: Have Princess Peach join the party after the wedding at Marrymore.

achievements.name: Star Piece
achievements.detail: Recover one of the seven Star Pieces.

achievements.name: Timed Hit
achievements.detail: Land an action command by pressing the button with the right timing in battle.

achievements.name: Triple Move
achievements.detail: Perform a Triple Move after the action gauge fills in battle.

achievements.name: Defeat Culex
achievements.detail: Defeat the optional boss Culex in Monstro Town.

achievements.name: Culex 3D
achievements.detail: Defeat Culex 3D in the postgame rematch at Monstro Town.

achievements.name: Journey's End
achievements.detail: Win the last battle of the story.
